To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) Machine Learning can be used for a large number of applications in telecommunications, including network planning, dimensioning, and management, (ii) Machine Learning is a very powerful tool for network optimization, but it is not a magic wand that solves everything; it has to be combined with other tools and methods, and (iii) the Machine Learning algorithms have to be tailored to the specific application and context, and the results have to be carefully evaluated.

(i) Machine Learning can be used to solve optimization problems that were previously unsolvable; (ii) Machine Learning can improve the quality of the solutions obtained for optimization problems that can be solved without it; (iii) Machine Learning can help to reduce the time required to solve a given optimization problem.

Machine Learning is a powerful tool to improve the performance of telecom networks, and it has already been used for a number of different applications, but there is a lot of room for further research and applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of Machine Learning to the following topics: (a) optical networks, (b) wireless networks and (c) network management and operations.
the application of Machine Learning to the optimization of network resources.
how Machine Learning can help us to design, operate, and optimize telecommunications networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Machine Learning is not a panacea, but it can be a very effective tool for telecoms to improve the performance of their systems.
Machine Learning has a lot to offer to telecommunications networks, and telecommunications networks have a lot to offer as a testbed to Machine Learning.
Machine Learning is already a reality in the telecommunications world, but there are many more opportunities to be exploited.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning, is a powerful tool to improve the efficiency of the network, and to provide new services.

Machine Learning is a powerful optimization tool for telecoms, and that the telecommunications industry can benefit from Machine Learning in many ways, including: network design and planning, network management, network monitoring, and network operation.

the Machine Learning techniques can help to optimize the network design and the operation of telecommunications networks, in order to improve the network performance, reduce operational costs, and improve the Quality-of-Experience (QoE).
The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of Machine Learning and telecommunications networks can be a win-win situation: the industry can benefit from the Machine Learning algorithms to improve the performance of their networks and the algorithms themselves can be improved by the availability of new datasets and the possibility of running them on large scale systems.

, although there is no single AI/ML algorithm that can be applied to every problem in telecommunications networks, the combination of AI/ML and telecommunications is a promising area of research and industry.
Machine Learning can be used for both network optimization and network operation.
